svg.title: Featured projects
svg.desc: Tindero: Pre-loved and community marketplace for the Philippines. Role-based access, passkey sign-in, and Android/iOS apps from one codebase. Kamayo: Interactive Filipino Sign Language learning system. 100-level path, server-checked progress and row-level security on every record. PandeLoot: Daily “loot drop” storefront for Filipino bakery treats, with Gemini-powered features and live drops. Anna: Private AI companion that runs entirely on your own PC. Reads only approved folders, remembers what you allow, and suggests instead of editing. GitHub Profile Viewer: Search any GitHub user for live stats, a contribution heatmap with snake animation, top repos and language breakdown.
